title: Versioned Product-Authority Reconciliation and Independent Release-Gate Enforcement

original_source.conversation: ChatGPT OpsControl Product Guide authority questionnaire

registration_provenance.authority: Owner-provided decision text in the current task is authoritative for registration

decision: Establish and maintain a versioned reconciliation of all applicable OpsControl product-authority decisions through AUTH-694 against all 31 included product journeys; all 14 sequential development-closure steps; actual implementation/integration; superseded, excluded and withdrawn requirements; automated evidence/gaps; formal owner UAT requirements; cross-journey dependencies/blockers; and independent security, durability, qualification and production-release gates.
mandatory_rule: Product-authority approval must never be treated as proof of implementation, successful testing, certification, owner UAT acceptance or production release readiness.
included_scope: Windows/Linux host, process and service monitoring
Background alert lifecycle, correlation and automated recovery

spool_status.note: Approval of centralized PostgreSQL-backed durable spool architecture is not completed implementation or verified recovery; no alternative architecture is substituted.

closure_evidence_rule.rule: Local resolution or assumed external closure does not establish provider-verified external closure. Do not display/assert external closure as verified without qualified evidence. Preserve original B/C selections without inventing unrecovered option wording.
closure_evidence_rule.option_to_state_mapping: SOURCE_NOT_RECOVERED; no mapping between B/C and either closure type is invented
